payload.title: Adverse events by subject
payload.subtitle: Top {@top_n} Adverse Event {@ae_variable}, by {label(@group)}
payload.script:
top_n <- 25  #| number(min = 1, label = "Top adverse events")
ae_variable <- factor("AEDECOD", levels = c("AEDECOD", "AETERM"))
.keep <- names(sort(table(data[[as.character(ae_variable)]]), decreasing = TRUE))
data[data[[as.character(ae_variable)]] %in% utils::head(.keep, top_n), ]
